21346.name: Power Bank (25K, 165W, Built-In and Retractable Cables)

bullets.title: Triple 100W USB-C Ports for Multi-Device
bullets.text: Designed for multitaskers, featuring three USB-C ports each delivering up to 100W, allowing you to power a MacBook and other devices simultaneously.

bullets.title: 25,000mAh for Long-Haul Power
bullets.text: Set off on extended journeys with a huge 25,000mAh capacity that supports your devices through multiple uses, complete with 100W ultra-fast recharging that fuels the power bank to 30% in just 20 minutes.

bullets.title: Dual Built-In Cables for On-the-Go Use
bullets.text: Equipped with two USB-C cables, one extendable up to 2.3 ft for over 20,000 retractions, and another at 0.98 ft that acts as a durable carrying strap capable of enduring more than 20,000 bends.

bullets.title: Charge 4 Devices at Once
bullets.text: Never run out of power, whether you're charging smartphones, tablets, or other USB-enabled devices. Connect up to four at once thanks to dual USB-C Cables, a USB-A port, and a USB-C port.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Power Bank (25K, 165W, Built-In and Retractable Cables), user manual, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Extra Small
bullets.text: You can hold it in one hand. Perfectly fits in small pouches and bags while you travel.

bullets.title: Ideal For Travel
bullets.text: The lightweight and compact design features a UK plug (Type G), a European plug (Type E/F), and a US plug (add the type) so you can use your original chargers and appliances in almost any country.

bullets.title: 4-in-1
bullets.text: Equipped with 1 AC outlet, 2 USB ports, and a 30W max USB-C port to simultaneously power up to 4 devices.

bullets.title: Superior Safety
bullets.text: Our 6-point safety system features short-circuit protection, fire resistance, grounded protection, and more to ensure safety for you and your devices.

21413.name: MagGo Wireless Charging Station (3-in-1, Foldable Pad)

bullets.title: 15W Ultra-Fast Wireless Charging
bullets.text: Swiftly power up your iPhone 15 Pro to 20% in just 15 minutes and an Apple Watch Series 9 to 30% in 22 minutes with this certified and MagSafe-compatible wireless charger.

bullets.title: Portable 3-in-1 Design
bullets.text: Keep your workspace clutter-free by charging multiple devices simultaneously on this foldable, baseball-sized Qi2 wireless charging station.

bullets.title: Convenient Viewing Mode
bullets.text: Enhance your iPhone's usability with a landscape viewing mode and StandBy support when the charger is folded.

bullets.title: Complete Package
bullets.text: Includes the Anker MagGo Wireless Charging Station, 40W adapter, 5 ft USB-C cable, welcome guide, and a 12-month warranty backed by friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Lightweight and Durable
bullets.text: Weighs only 300g and is made from aluminum alloy for greater stability and durability.

bullets.title: Flexible Viewing Angles
bullets.text: Supports 360° vertical and horizontal rotation to unlock more viewing angles.

bullets.title: Wide Compatibility
bullets.text: Universal 1/4 inch screw mount with a maximum load capacity of 1 kg

bullets.title: Excellent Protection
bullets.text: No need to worry about dirt, dust, splashes, collisions, or scratches when packing up for a party.

bullets.title: High-Quality Materials
bullets.text: The exterior material is polyurethane waterproof material, which feels delicate and can be taken outside with no worry.

21466.name: Capsule Air | The World’s Smallest Google TV Projector

bullets.title: Soda-Can Sized for Limitless Portability
bullets.text: The ultra-compact and lightweight design fits right in your hand so you can take your entertainment anywhere.

bullets.title: Ultra-Portable Google TV Mini Projector
bullets.text: Access all the content you could ever need with support for over 30,000 apps on Google Play, including officially licensed Netflix.

bullets.title: 2 Hours of Built-In Playtime
bullets.text: Watch a full movie or several episodes of your favorite show wherever you are thanks to the 34Wh built-in battery.

bullets.title: Unlock More Ways to Watch with Official Accessories
bullets.text: Our snap-on base lets you adjust the angle of the projector, or mount it on a wall, offering more flexible viewing options.

bullets.title: Next-Level Image Quality
bullets.text: The 720p display with 150 ANSI Lumens of brightness makes movies shine for an immersive watching experience.

bullets.title: Soundcore Wireless Earbuds
bullets.text: Immerse in crystal-clear audio and up to 36 hours of uninterrupted playback with the K20i semi-in-ear earbuds from the renowned Soundcore brand.

bullets.title: Engineered for Powerful Sound
bullets.text: Equipped with 13mm dynamic drivers, innovative torus design, and BassUp technology, these earbuds deliver rich, immersive sound ideal for music, podcasts, and gaming.

bullets.title: Comfortable Fit
bullets.text: The lightweight (3.3g) semi-in-ear design ensures a secure, comfortable fit without the need for ear tips, allowing you to wear them all day long.

bullets.title: Clear Calls and Voice Control
bullets.text: Dual-mic AI-powered noise reduction technology isolates your voice from background noise, ensuring pristine call quality and enabling intuitive touch control for seamless audio management.

bullets.title: Personalized Listening Experience
bullets.text: With 22 preset EQ settings and customizable options through the app, you can tailor the sound to your personal preferences.

bullets.title: Gaming Edge
bullets.text: Step up your gaming experience with the specialized Game Mode, enhancing audio clarity and spatial awareness for a competitive advantage.

bullets.title: Wide Compatibility
bullets.text: This replacement battery is fully compatible with eufy Robot Vacuum L50/L60 series, including eufy L50, eufy L50 with Self-Empty Station, eufy L60, eufy L60 with Self-Empty Station, eufy L60 Hybrid, and eufy L60 Hybrid with Self-Empty Station.

bullets.title: Reliable Battery Performance
bullets.text: Made with high-quality battery cells, offering top-tier safety features against short circuiting, overcharging, over-discharging, and overheating. It boasts a durable lifespan, with running times of 60 to 180 minutes. (Note: The actual running time will vary based on the machine model and its operating mode.)

bullets.title: Easy to Install
bullets.text: Simply remove your vacuum's battery cover, unlatch to take out the old battery, then insert the new one with the sticker side up. Ensure the battery wires are neatly tucked inside the compartment for a perfect fit.

bullets.title: After-Sale Service
bullets.text: We are dedicated to providing excellent customer service. Our friendly support team is available 24/7 to assist with any questions or concerns.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: To protect your robot vacuum machine and extend its lifespan, buying our branded robot vacuum replacement parts is recommended

bullets.title: Crystal-Clear Welcome in 2K FHD
bullets.text: Experience 2K FHD clarity for detailed and vivid visuals, ensuring you can see exactly who is at your door, even at night. The 16:9 expanded view provides a wider picture of your entire front door area, offering enhanced security and peace of mind.

bullets.title: Real-Time Chat, Seamless Experience
bullets.text: Stay connected with your visitors in real time. When someone rings the doorbell, you'll receive a pop-up video call on your phone. If you're not at home, you can set up quick responses and ask visitors to leave voice memos, ensuring you never miss an important message.

bullets.title: Easy Setup, Convenient Power
bullets.text: Enjoy the flexibility of easy installation with the built-in 5,000 mAh battery, allowing you to place the doorbell wherever you prefer without worrying about wiring.

bullets.title: Local Storage, No Monthly Fee
bullets.text: Keep your footage secure and private with local storage. Store recordings on a microSD card with up to 128 GB capacity, eliminating the need for monthly subscription fees and ensuring your data remains under your control.

bullets.title: Compatible with HomeBase 3
bullets.text: Works with Alexa & Google Assistant: Seamlessly integrate your doorbell with a range of devices. Pair with the eufy HomeBase S380, eufy Minibase Chime (T8023), and enjoy compatibility with Alexa and Google Voice Assistant devices for a fully connected smart home experience.

bullets.title: Next-Gen Smart Security
bullets.text: Enjoy enhanced performance by upgrading your app to the latest version (Android 4.9.3_4359, iOS 4.9.35_1651) for a seamless user experience.

bullets.title: 4K Ultra-Clear, 24/7 Recording
bullets.text: Capture every detail, day or night, with crystal-clear 4K recording. Stay connected with family and pets using the built-in two-way audio for real-time communication.

bullets.title: 360° Panoramic View
bullets.text: Easily navigate your home's view with new app features like Quick Focus Tap and Panoramic View, allowing you to instantly switch focus by tapping the desired area on your screen.

bullets.title: AI-Powered Detection & Smart Auto Tracking
bullets.text: Harness the power of advanced on-device AI to distinguish humans, pets, audio cues, and crying sounds. The camera automatically tracks movement when a person or pet is detected, providing a complete view of their activity.

bullets.title: Color Night Vision with Built-In Spotlight
bullets.text: The integrated spotlight allows seamless switching between color night vision and infrared night vision for crystal-clear nighttime surveillance. The spotlight also doubles as a deterrent.

bullets.title: Smart Home Compatibility
bullets.text: Works effortlessly with HomeKit, Alexa, and Google Assistant for enhanced home automation. (Note: HomeKit supports up to 1080P resolution.)

bullets.title: Local Storage & No Monthly Fees
bullets.text: Store your footage locally with an SD card (sold separately) and enjoy all functions without any subscription fees. Cloud storage options are also available.

bullets.title: 360° Vision, Every Corner in Sight
bullets.text: With 360° pan and 70° tilt, this camera ensures no blind spots, allowing you to monitor your front porch yard and even keep an eye on your driveway.

bullets.title: AI Auto Lock and Tracking
bullets.text: With built-in Al and 360° pan, you can get motion-tracking recordings of the detected object, whether a human or a vehicle.

bullets.title: Stay Charged With Forever Power
bullets.text: With a removable solar panel, 2 hours of daily sun keeps the camera charged. SolarPlus™ technology gives you always-on security and constant peace of mind.

bullets.title: Enhanced 2K Clarity Day and Night
bullets.text: Experience crystal-clear 2K clarity day and night, capturing every detail that matters. With an f/1.6 aperture and 2K Clarity, our product always ensures superior image quality.

bullets.title: No Monthly Fee
bullets.text: Keep your footage private with a microSD card up to 128 GB (microSD card not included), with no subscription fees.
